log_mel_spectrograms.description: A `[..., num_mel_bins]` `float32`/`float64` `Tensor` of log-magnitude mel-scale spectrograms.

name.description: An optional name for the operation.

output.description: A `[..., num_mel_bins]` `float32`/`float64` `Tensor` of the MFCCs of `log_mel_spectrograms`.

constraints: log_mel_spectrograms shape must match the rank expected by the function.
num_mel_bins in output matches num_mel_bins in input.
